verdict.rationale: pnpm's core workflow is a single `pnpm install` that resolves and links all declared dependencies from package.json/lockfile, with frozen-lockfile enforcement in CI (docs-13, docs-34) ensuring reproducible bootstrapping, and community reports confirm fast, reliable installs on fresh clones/monorepos (pnpm-comm-5, pnpm-comm-14, pnpm-comm-17). The content-addressable store and node_modules linking (docs-15, docs-28) further support consistent installs across machines. Missing for 10: an explicit doc snippet naming the single `pnpm install` bootstrap command/flow rather than inferring it from CI/lockfile docs, and independent benchmarking beyond anecdotal HN comments.
